- [mixing.errors](_autosummary/mixing.errors.html.md): Typed errors &#96;mixing&#96; raises — the home for exceptions a caller may want to catch.
- [mixing.srt](_autosummary/mixing.srt.html.md): Canonical SRT / timeline parsing and formatting (pure, dependency-free).
- [mixing.transcript](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.html.md): Transcript-driven media editing.
- [mixing.transcript.fillers](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.fillers.html.md): Filler-word detection over Scribe-shaped word lists.
- [mixing.transcript.formats](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.formats.html.md): Transcript output formats: SRT, plain prose, time remapping.
- [mixing.transcript.media](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.media.html.md): ffmpeg-backed audio extraction and timeline-cut application.
- [mixing.transcript.persist](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.persist.html.md): Reuse-or-create the SRT that lives next to a media file.
- [mixing.transcript.pipeline](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.pipeline.html.md): High-level filler-removal pipeline.
- [mixing.transcript.scribe](_autosummary/mixing.transcript.scribe.html.md): ElevenLabs Scribe (speech-to-text) HTTP client.
- [mixing.util](_autosummary/mixing.util.html.md): General utilities for mixing video, audio, etc.
